t: Also, dressing up with grace and elegance, according to your own cultural norms, immensely boosts your self-confidence and your self-worth, raises your vibration, and makes you feel happy and motivated in life. It is a way of earning respect and feeling in control of your own life. Makes a huge impact on your mental and physical well-being - and also on your performance ❤

1. Loud logos —elegance is understated not flashy
2. Overly bright colors —you can wear bright colors but choose tones that compliment you not overwhelm you 
3. Clothes that are too tight or overly revealing —it’s not about covering up, it’s about intention and balance. 
4. Overly distressed denim —avoid rips, frays, and fading 
5. Clashing trends -instead of layering trends just find what works for you and balance it out
6. Too may clashing colors or patterns -ground it versus creating visual noise 
7. Overlooked or mismatched accessories —it’s about how it’s styled, opting for harmony and polish
8. Worn down/uncared for clothing —make sure your clothes look their best as a form of self respect
Poise, Posture, and Presence = An Elegant Woman

The ones complaining about bright colors not looking classy especially my melanated sisters, is missing what she said due to being triggered. She’s not saying loud/neon colors in general aren’t elegant, you just need to pair them with another color that’ll absorb or filter some of the “noise”. If your intention is to be loud and bold then go ahead ladies, but if your intention is to be elegant, overwhelming intense colors being the entire outfit isn’t the way to go.
